'''Rulaar''' was a celestial body in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Rulaarian pleasure yacht]] existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Deathgame" />
